findings.title: Same concurrent-delete NPE remains in getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: The fix null-checks modelSupplier.get() in getSubGroupsCount, but getSubGroupsStream(search,first,max), getSubGroupsStream(first,max), and getSubGroupsStream(search,exact,first,max) still do modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) with no null check. If the group is deleted concurrently the supplier returns null (the exact case this PR fixes) and those methods still throw NullPointerException, so the concurrent list/brief path is not fixed.

findings.title: Concurrent test thread is never joined
findings.body: The test starts a reader thread with new Thread(...).start() and then asserts caughtExceptions immediately after setting deletedAll without join/wait. The assertion can run before the reader thread finishes, so failures can be missed, and the leaked thread can keep hitting the server during subsequent tests causing flakiness and resource leaks.
